body.name: Coordinate baseline gauge
body.construction: Because \(q_i^0\) is a density with respect to \(d\lambda(s)=ds/(2\pi)\), define the lift \(\overline\beta_{\theta i}(t)=\int_0^tq_i^0(s)ds\). Then \(\overline\beta_{\theta i}(t+2\pi)=\overline\beta_{\theta i}(t)+2\pi\) and \(\overline\beta_{\theta i}'=q_i^0>0\), so \(\beta_{\theta i}=\overline\beta_{\theta i}\pmod{2\pi}\) is an orientation-preserving degree-one circle diffeomorphism and \((\beta_{\theta i})_*(q_i^0d\lambda)=d\lambda\). Set \(\beta_\theta=(\beta_{\theta1},\ldots,\beta_{\theta n})\) and \(F_\theta=f\circ\beta_\theta^{-1}\).
